name: menu-maker
description: Keep your menu in a spreadsheet and get a good-looking printed menu and a phone-friendly web menu from it. Sections, prices with dotted leaders, chef's picks, spice levels, vegetarian and allergen tags, and English names side by side — in a classic, two-column or compact layout on A4, A5 or Letter. Add the web menu's address and a QR code is printed on the menu for guests to scan. Change a price or mark a dish sold out and export again. Runs locally; no menu service or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 菜单放在表格里维护，就能生成好看的打印菜单和适合手机看的电子菜单。分类、带虚线引导的价格、招牌推荐、辣度、素食和过敏原标记、中英文菜名并排——经典单栏、双栏或紧凑版式，A4、A5 或 Letter 纸张。填上电子菜单的网址，打印菜单上会印出二维码给客人扫。改价格、标记售罄后重新导出即可。在本地运行，不用菜单服务，无需 API 密钥。
